slides.headline: His mother was born in Odisha and studied at Delhi University before Harvard. In 2026, her son became mayor of America's largest city.
Zohran Mamdani was sworn in as the 112th Mayor of New York City on January 1, 2026
slides.body: He won the election with 50.4% of the vote against Andrew Cuomo's 41.6%, becoming the first person of South Asian heritage to lead America's largest city.

slides.headline: His mother, filmmaker Mira Nair, was born in Rourkela, Odisha, in 1957.
slides.body: She studied at Delhi University before earning a scholarship to Harvard, going on to direct acclaimed films including Salaam Bombay! and Monsoon Wedding - Mamdani himself was born in Kampala, Uganda, and moved to New York at age seven.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: A Viksit Bharat benefits when its diaspora's children end up leading the world's major cities.
slides.body: Mamdani's path - an India-born mother's education and career feeding into her son's rise to lead New York City - shows the diaspora's influence compounding across generations, not fading with distance.
